This document outlines the equipment inspection list I1, 
 which must be performed every one year as indicated by (Y1) in the above title 
 block.

This 
 pump is used to transfer the sewage water from the collection tank to the 
 aeration tank

The 
 first draft initiated by eng. Abdel Mageed Elhenawey, revised by MDEPCo. Quality control Eng. Magdy Hegazy, accepted by 
 eng . Magdy Okba, and approved by eng Saeed Sowan , accepted by eng. Samir Abdel Gilil; MEPC 
 inspection & quality control general Manager& MPIS coordinator, and certified 
 by Eng Mohamed Nageeb inspection & quality control's head sector.

rows: J-40 TWGS & centrifugal horizontal self-priming pump

items:
A work permit must be issued and 
 the qualified maintenance staff should carry the suitable safety category

Safety fence with caution marks 
 surrounding the work area is required

Wear safety and healthy equipment 
 as safety helmet, safety shoes breathing mask ... etc

Isolate the circuit breaker of 
 the pump motor

Disconnect electric terminals of 
 the pump motor

Isolate the pump mechanically by 
 closing delivery and suction values

Be sure pump must be completely 
 drained
Complete maintenance tool set
Cleaning fluid. Manual puller
Feeler gauge dial indicator
Vibrometer straight edge rags
Checks pump capacity, pressure and power.
Check the Noisy of the Pump.

Measure vibration level for bearings and compare it with the setting value 
 then analyze it and determine what to do
Check the temperature of bearing
Check the leakage of the mechanical seal
Check alignment and compare it with the setting value
Adjust mechanical seal leakage

Check the pump and piping flanges for Leaks and Re-tight if 
 needed.
Check the bolts fixation
Check pump from rust Re-paint if needed

sections.text:
Before starting the pump, the 
following steps should be checked

items: Check the direction of rotation of motor before starting.
Check the oil level in the oiler
Filling the pump casing with the liquid

sections.text:
Attendance and checking during 
operation of the pump, the following should be checked

items: Check of flow rate and pressure of pump
Check the mechanical seal for leaks
Check that the current absorbed by the motor

Introduction
This document outlines the equipment inspection list I1, 
 which must be performed every one year as indicated by (Y1) in the above title 
 block.
This 
 pump is used to transfer the sewage water from the collection tank to the 
 aeration tank
The 
 first draft initiated by eng. Abdel Mageed Elhenawey, revised by MDEPCo. Quality control Eng. Magdy Hegazy, accepted by 
 eng . Magdy Okba, and approved by eng Saeed Sowan , accepted by eng. Samir Abdel Gilil; MEPC 
 inspection & quality control general Manager& MPIS coordinator, and certified 
 by Eng Mohamed Nageeb inspection & quality control's head sector.

Safety 
Precautions
A work permit must be issued and 
 the qualified maintenance staff should carry the suitable safety category
Safety fence with caution marks 
 surrounding the work area is required
Wear safety and healthy equipment 
 as safety helmet, safety shoes breathing mask ... etc
Isolate the circuit breaker of 
 the pump motor
Disconnect electric terminals of 
 the pump motor
Isolate the pump mechanically by 
 closing delivery and suction values
Be sure pump must be completely 
 drained
Tools 
and Equipment
Complete maintenance tool set
Cleaning fluid. Manual puller
Feeler gauge dial indicator
Vibrometer straight edge rags
Work to be 
carried out
Pump in operation
Checks pump capacity, pressure and power.
Check the Noisy of the Pump.
Measure vibration level for bearings and compare it with the setting value 
 then analyze it and determine what to do
Check the temperature of bearing
Check the leakage of the mechanical seal
Pump out of 
operation
Check alignment and compare it with the setting value
Adjust mechanical seal leakage
Check the pump and piping flanges for Leaks and Re-tight if 
 needed.
Check the bolts fixation
Check pump from rust Re-paint if needed
Starting the pump
Before starting the pump, the 
following steps should be checked
Check the direction of rotation of motor before starting.
Check the oil level in the oiler
Filling the pump casing with the liquid
Attendance and checking during 
operation of the pump, the following should be checked
Check of flow rate and pressure of pump
Check the mechanical seal for leaks
Check that the current absorbed by the motor
